periods.label: Week of August 24, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: Performance Upgrades and Community Panel Overhaul

features: Implemented an AI development maintenance mode fallback system, improving stability for AI task management.
bugfixes: Resolved several inventory issues related to spell extraction, ensuring tooltips are correctly displayed and spell previews are cleared properly.
Restored camera orbit controls for Firefox users to ensure consistent movement experience.
Improved the mobile experience by fixing layout issues within inventory and ensuring item descriptions remain visible on screen.
performance: Significant performance boost applied to combat text rendering by utilizing cached canvases and opacity fading, reducing overhead per frame.
Reduced frame costs associated with spell effects and auras through optimizations like bounded light polling and allocation-free area checks.
ux: The Community Change Request panel was updated, including a renaming of the panel and the addition of a dedicated 'Graphics & Sounds' submission category for assets and effects.

commits.title: feat(AI-dev): add maintenance mode fallback to when there's no available tasks
fix(inventory): show the extracted spell when hovering the Extract action
commits.description:
- resolve the context menu portal when opening instead of when the card is built, so the menu stays inside the HUD root and the viewport tooltip listeners can see it
- raise the viewport tooltip overlay above the context menu z-index for both the spell and fallback tooltips
- add a regression test keeping the Extract tooltip reachable from the open menu

commits.title: perf(combat-text): allocate floating text canvases once and fade via opacity
commits.description:
- cached canvas + CanvasTexture per combat text, redrawn only when value, kind, or critical state changes
- per-frame fade now updates sprite material opacity instead of re-uploading the texture
- moved formatCombatAmount to CombatText and added combatTextRenderSignature with unit tests
- extended the runtime performance contract spec accordingly

commits.title: ux(devlog): rename request panel and add Graphics & Sounds category
commits.description:
- renamed 'Request a feature or report a bug' heading to 'Community Change Request'
- added Graphics & Sounds request type for assets, effects, particles, and engine details
- extended kind validation, badge label, and specs

commits.title: fix(camera): restore Firefox mouse drag orbit
fix(inventory): clear spell preview after extraction
perf(spells): reduce effect and aura frame costs
commits.description:
- retain persistent spell visuals and shared capped particle resources
- bound Thunder Aura light jitter polling while preserving continuous fades
- use allocation-free squared-distance area checks

commits.title: fix(mobile): improve inventory and resource HUD layout
